description: A small white glasses case sits on the bed in front of you, with a dark pillow at the head of the bed. The left hand reaches in from the left and the right hand from the right to make the case a two-hand object, lifting and rotating it upright; the right hand opens the flap while the left hand steadies it, then the right hand pulls the glasses out to become a right-hand object as the left hand releases the case and the glasses are set down on the bed to the right of the open case.
